newsitem.title: USA: Texas executes man convicted in 1985 murder.
newsitem.headline: Texas executes man convicted in 1985 murder.

text.p: A man convicted of murdering a Texas woman during a 1985 crime spree was executed on Friday by lethal injection at the state prison here, prison officials said.

Clifton Eugene Belyeu, 38, was sentenced to death for the shooting and stabbing death of Melodie Bolton, who was killed while Belyeu and an accomplice robbed her home in December 1985, officials said.

"God help you, because what your (sic) doing here today and what's in your hearts here today makes you no better than any man or woman on death-rows across this country," Belyeu said in a statement released following his execution.
"Today your (sic) commiting (sic) murder too," he said.

The execution in the death chamber of the Huntsville State Prison was witnessed by Bolton's husband, son and other members of her family, along with reporters and prison officials. None of Belyeu's family witnessed the execution.
